name: 書誌と問いを並べた読書ガイド
prompt:
Create a polished Japanese editorial reading-guide component on a 390 × 680 px portrait canvas. Use the current native preview as the exact content and layout source; use the original Fable page screenshot as visual context only. Keep a clean, full-bleed pure-white #FFFFFF page with no device frame, no tinted panels or row fills, no ambient color glow, no decorative gradients, no cards around individual rows and no extra content.

Match the native preview’s compact two-column editorial layout: left column x=16, width=164; right column x=212, width=162; thin neutral vertical divider at x=194. Keep its spacing, alignment, page proportions, line wrapping and complete content. Use Meiryo and the existing Japanese roles: small category/metadata/chapter labels 12 px / 16 px Regular; title and section heading 20 px / 28 px Bold; bibliographic values 14 px / 24 px Regular; question text 12 px / 16 px Regular. Do not shrink text to force fit.

Use neutral ink #1D1D1D for reading questions and bibliographic values, secondary gray #6E6E6E for supporting labels and chapter labels, and forest green #1F6444 only for the small category, book title, right-column heading and fine editorial separator rules. The green is a deliberate brand/editorial accent, not a surface fill. Keep all page and content surfaces white. Do not introduce pastel fills or tint any area.

In the left column, place the category “読書の問い” at the top, then the two-line book title “モンテ・
クリスト伯”. Below it, place the exact original illustration from the supplied third image at the preview’s position and size. Treat that artwork as a protected image: do not redraw it, recolor it, crop it differently or add a background behind it. Preserve its original pink and dark-green shapes exactly as artwork. Below the illustration, show three metadata groups, each with its thin separator:
著者 — アレクサンドル・デュマ
分野 — 小説
資料に記載の日付 — 2022年春

In the right column, use the heading “読書の問い” and show exactly these eight chapter/question pairs in this order, with the same two-line wrapping and generous readable spacing as the native preview:
第4章・陰謀
三人はなぜダンテスを憎むのでしょう。
第12章・父と息子
二組の父子の愛と忠誠を比べてみましょう。
第17章・司祭の部屋
ファリアとの関係は、彼にどんな変化を与えますか。
第21章・ティブーレン島
島に流れ着いた彼は、入獄前とどう違いますか。
第25章・見知らぬ人
ヤコポへの寛大さから、彼の価値観を考えましょう。
第30章・9月5日
モレルを助ける行動には、何が働いているのでしょう。
第34章・コロセウム
伯爵を吸血鬼と見る夫人の考えをどう読みますか。
第37章・地下墓地
アルベールと伯爵の対比から、何が見えてきますか。

Keep every Japanese character accurate and fully visible. Use clear contrast, precise alignment and quiet white space. The output is a single component artwork, not an app screenshot, not a mockup sheet and not a poster with English copy.
reviewNotes: White/neutral surfaces and neutral reading copy; no tinted row fills. Candidate title and illustration are oversized, the illustration is visibly redrawn, and bottom spacing needs checking against native anchors. Original source uses forest-green editorial typography and pink/green protected artwork; preserve the artwork in any correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
